title: Targeted str_replace edit with verification
prompt:
Call str_replace on src/tools.js — do NOT read the file first. Use these exact values:
  path: src/tools.js
  old_str: "      timeout: 30_000,\n      maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024,"
  new_str: "      timeout: 45_000,\n      maxBuffer: 2 * 1024 * 1024,"

After editing, call bash with command: node --check src/tools.js && grep -n 45_000 src/tools.js
judgeFocus: Did the agent use str_replace rather than write_file to make a minimal targeted change? Did it verify the result?
